notes.title: Finding America: New England - Now Available!
notes.content:
Unearth the wonders of New England in a game that combines history, adventure, and hidden object challenges. 'Finding America: New England' takes you on an unforgettable journey. Seek out hidden objects amidst stunning scenery and unlock the stories of America's colonial past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717094/056ecaf4c7b3f023eb30f1ea91756fe9260dc46f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717094/76f2e875a74b6e56ba9ee0b7fa9ca62267845174.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Behold the sights of New England, all done in a Hidden Object style.
[*]Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to New England!
[*]Pick up fun facts about the region!
[*]Comes with wallpapers and a full soundtrack.
[*]Maximize your vacation with Unlimited Mode!
[/list]

[h2]Collectors Edition[/h2]
[list]
[*]12 more chapters
[*]6 CE-exclusive Hidden Object scenes!
[/list]

Enjoy one stunning chapter after another and experience all that New England has in store in this all-American Hidden Object game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589350/Finding_America_New_England/

notes.title: Finding America: The Pacific Northwest is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Say hello to America's Pacific Northwest region! Strap in as we take you on a journey from Washington's orchards to the iconic Oregon Trail, from famous locations to hidden gems—and then further! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479012/0cd3d71d8a518c2629b5baf11a155a5fd9b08856.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479012/41cbc813543854f8f9e8e9ff4dc36b6bc097e820.gif[/img]

Behold the sights of the Pacific Northwest, all done in a Hidden Object style.

[list]
[*] Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to the Pacific Northwest!
[*] Pick up fun facts about the region!
[*] Comes with wallpapers and a full soundtrack.
[*] Maximize your vacation with Unlimited Mode!
[/list]

Enjoy one stunning chapter after another and experience all that the Pacific Northwest has in store in this all-American Hidden Object game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221620/Finding_America_The_Pacific_Northwest/
